name: A10-0175/2025 – Emma Wiesner, Pekka Toveri – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Council Decision 89/367/EEC setting up a Standing Forestry Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to reshape a long-standing committee that brings together the European Commission and Member States on forests. The committee would be renamed the Standing Forest and Forestry Expert Group. It would advise the Commission on any forest-related policy, give opinions on proposals that affect forests, and report back on how those opinions were used. Member States would be strongly encouraged to send national experts. The Parliament also stresses that forests are mainly a national responsibility.

- The committee becomes an expert group that advises the Commission and can issue opinions on forest policies.
- It affects Member States' forest authorities and the Commission; each country is urged to send experts.
- The Parliament has set its position; talks with Member States follow before the change becomes law.
